europe_now.title: Germany Blames Russia for Airport Drone Attack
europe_now.summary: Germany has officially blamed Russia for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport and announced retaliatory measures, including closing a Russian consulate.

europe_now.title: EU Bans Brazilian Meat and Dairy
europe_now.summary: European Union officials have confirmed a ban on meat and dairy imports from Brazil due to ongoing health concerns.

top_stories.title: UK Parliamentary Developments
top_stories.summary: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham faced lawmakers in the House of Commons for the first time since taking office. During his debut appearance, he outlined his initial legislative agenda and pledged to restore national hope.

top_stories.title: European Union Trade and Security Policy
top_stories.summary: EU defense ministers recently met to discuss pressing security issues while navigating regional defense challenges. Meanwhile, European officials continue to monitor trade pressures and international regulatory standards.
